```
verify(root48, key32, pkt):
  parse hdr; assert magic, ver, type, 1<=m<=32
  Cs = [root] + pkt.C_1..C_{m-1}         # len m

              y_i = fe(LEAFH(pkt.k_e, pkt.rec_e))
      ys.append(y_i)
  zs = [fe(key32[i]) for i in 0..m-1]
  r = fe(BLAKE3("MMLK-FS-V1", root48 || key32 || u8(m) || concat(compress(Cs[i]) for i>=1) || concat(fe_to_32be(ys))))
  D = sum r^t * Cs[t]
  p = interpolate([(zs[t], ys[t])])
  P = commit_g1(p)     # MSM with setup G1 powers
  Zpoly = prod (X - zs[t]); Zc = commit_g2(Zpoly)
  assert pairing(e(Q, Zc) == e(D - P, g1))
  if type==PRESENT and COORD_MODE==HASHED: assert pkt.rec.cc == queried_cc
  return True
```
